key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Luke’s shorter address and two petitions without importing added clauses.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, may your name be made holy. May your kingdom come.
key_decisions.after: He said to them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, may your name be kept holy. May your kingdom come.

key_decisions.after: Give us each day our daily bread.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Give us each day our daily bread.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves sins, human debtors, reciprocal forgiveness, and the final trial petition.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the locked household, shared sleeping arrangement, and refusal.

key_decisions.after: Then the friend inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. The door is already locked, and my children are in bed with me. I cannot get up and give you anything.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and that one inside will answer and say, ‘Do not trouble me; the door has already been shut, and my children are with me in bed; I am not able to rise and give to you’?

key_decisions.rationale: Retains friendship contrast, difficult anaideia, and sufficient provision.
key_decisions.before: I tell you, even if he will not get up and give him something because he is his friend, because of his shameless persistence he will get up and give him whatever he needs.
key_decisions.after: I tell you, even if he will not get up and give him bread because he is his friend, he will get up because of the man’s shameless persistence and give him whatever he needs.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I say to you, even if he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence he will rise and give him whatever he needs.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves all three repeated imperatives and promises.
key_decisions.before: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
key_decisions.after: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I say to you: ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains father-son relation and fish-snake contrast.
key_decisions.before: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
key_decisions.after: Which father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will instead of a fish give him a snake?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the harsh human assessment and Luke’s specific gift of the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.before: If you, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”
key_decisions.after: If you, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”

key_decisions.rationale: Clarifies the demon’s effect while distinguishing man and demon.
key_decisions.before: Jesus was casting out a demon that made a man unable to speak. When the demon went out, the man spoke, and the crowds were amazed.
key_decisions.after: Jesus was driving out a demon that kept a man from speaking. When the demon came out, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowds were amazed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he was casting out a demon that was mute; and it happened when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke, and the crowds marveled.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains accusation and title without correcting it in narration.
key_decisions.before: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.”
key_decisions.after: But some of them said, “He drives out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of demons.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But some of them said, “By Beelzebul, the ruler of demons, he casts out demons.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps their motive, demand, and heavenly source.
key_decisions.before: Others, testing him, kept seeking a sign from heaven from him.
key_decisions.after: Others tested him by demanding a sign from heaven.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And others, testing him, were seeking from him a sign from heaven.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Jesus’ knowledge and both political and household images.
key_decisions.before: But knowing their thoughts, he said, “Every kingdom divided against itself is devastated, and a divided house falls.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the conditional reasoning and direct link to their accusation.

key_decisions.after: If Satan is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? I ask because you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders “sons” as followers in this group relation and retains the judgment reversal.
key_decisions.before: If I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
key_decisions.after: If I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the concrete divine image and accomplished kingdom arrival.
key_decisions.before: But if I cast out demons by the finger of God, then God’s kingdom has come upon you.
key_decisions.after: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But if by the finger of God I cast out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains both uncompromising contrasts.

key_decisions.after: Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The one who is not with me is against me, and the one who does not gather with me scatters.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps unclean spirit, arid wandering, rest, and possessive house speech.

key_decisions.after: When an unclean spirit comes out of a person, it travels through waterless places seeking rest. Finding none, it says, ‘I will return to my house that I left.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “When the unclean spirit has gone out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and not finding it, it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves cleanliness and order without claiming genuine transformation.

key_decisions.after: When it arrives, it finds the house swept and put in order.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And coming, it finds it swept and put in order.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps exact number, comparative evil, indwelling, and worsening outcome.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains female royal witness, distant travel, wisdom, and greater-than comparison.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps repentance, proclamation, judgment, and second greater-than comparison.
